faqs.question: What is AI outsourcing?
faqs.answer: AI outsourcing is partnering with an external team to plan, build, integrate, or maintain AI systems. It gives organizations access to specialist skills and delivery capacity without building every capability in-house.

faqs.question: What AI roles can I add to my team?
faqs.answer: Depending on the work, you can bring in AI architects, data scientists, machine learning engineers, generative AI developers, MLOps specialists, and product or quality assurance expertise.

faqs.question: Can I hire a dedicated AI development team?
faqs.answer: Yes. A dedicated team can align to your product roadmap, tools, and delivery practices, with a scope and team mix tailored to your project.

faqs.question: Can you take responsibility for a full AI project?
faqs.answer: Yes. Engagements can cover discovery, architecture, data preparation, development, integration, deployment, and ongoing support.

faqs.question: How do you protect our data and intellectual property?
faqs.answer: We define data access, confidentiality, security controls, and ownership expectations for the engagement, based on your legal and technical requirements.

faqs.question: Which industries do you serve?
faqs.answer: AI capabilities can support healthcare, finance, retail, logistics, manufacturing, education, real estate, media, travel, and other sectors. The delivery approach is adapted to each domain.

faqs.question: Can the team work with our existing systems?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can integrate AI capabilities with your existing applications, APIs, cloud services, data platforms, and business systems.

faqs.question: How do you measure project success?
faqs.answer: We agree measurable goals with you, such as task quality, processing time, adoption, reliability, or operating cost, and review progress against those goals.

faqs.question: How quickly can an AI outsourcing team start?
faqs.answer: Timing depends on team availability, scope, access requirements, and onboarding. A focused discovery phase can clarify the team and delivery plan.

faqs.question: Do you provide ongoing maintenance after launch?
faqs.answer: Yes. Support can include monitoring, model and data updates, infrastructure maintenance, quality reviews, and continuous improvements.
